propositions: CREATE emit path drops a bound non-epic parent silently with only a logger.debug, producing no durable bridge_alerts record
ACLI attach fallback (slot 4) swallows HTTP 400 on set_parent with a WARNING but never calls record_parent_divergence, leaving no observability trace when Jira rejects the parent
Both slots 2 and 4 violate the stated contract (pass_io.py:113-118, dispatch_one.py:561-564) that an unreachable parent must leave a durable operator-visible record, not merely a log line

The fix threads a suppressed_out list through OutboundMapper.map_local_to_remote to report dropped bound (but not unbound) non-epic parents onto the existing dropped_field_sink → outbound-field-dropped channel
Slot 4 must call record_parent_divergence('outbound-parent-rejected', …) on the 400 branch, reusing the same helper dispatch_one uses for the identical shape on the UPDATE path
